en: I'm Bugsy! I never lose when it comes to Bug Pokémon. I've studied every one of them, inside and out.
Let me show you what I've learned!
Whoa, amazing! You really know your stuff. Okay, you win. This is yours: the Hive Badge!
{player} received the Hive Badge from Bugsy!
With the Hive Badge, Pokémon up to level thirty will obey you, and you can use Cut outside of battle.
Here, take this as well. It's a move my Bug Pokémon love.
TM89 is U-turn. Your Pokémon hits the foe, then swaps out for another. Hit and run, just like a bug!
Bug Pokémon are so deep. There's always something new to learn about them. I'm going to keep studying!
